Hello Luxe team. We'll land at Hanoi airport at around 11am. If an early check-in could be arranged that would be lovely, otherwise if we could just drop our bags until the room is ready that is fine too.

Dear Mr. [khách],

Warm greetings from the Reception Desk of Luxe Paradise Suites Hotel & Spa. Thank you for your message and for sharing your flight arrival time at around 11:00.

We have noted your request for an early check-in. Early check-in can be requested and is subject to room availability. If the room is not ready, we are happy to store your luggage securely until your room becomes available.

We can also arrange airport transfer services. Our official rates are:
- 4-seater Big Space: 400,000 VND one way / 700,000 VND round trip.
- 7-seater SUV Big Space: 500,000 VND one way / 850,000 VND round trip.
- 16-seater Van Big Space: 800,000 VND one way / 1,450,000 VND round trip.

If you would like us to arrange a transfer, please let us know your flight number, arrival date and exact arrival time, number of passengers and whether you need one-way or round-trip. For international arrivals the driver waits outside at Column 3; for domestic arrivals the driver waits outside at Column 12.

Thank you very much. We look forward to welcoming you soon.

Warmest regards,
Reception Desk
Luxe Paradise Suites Hotel & Spa
